decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program draws on core clinical competence, is reimbursed by health insurers and has been presented consistently on its own page, so it is likely to continue.
The custom-furniture carpentry workshop provides meaningful sheltered employment and uses established production know-how, so it remains integral even after the retail shop closed.
Senior living counseling is low-cost, featured on the home page and channels clients to the firm's eldercare facilities, so it is very likely retained.
The meal delivery service is new and only mentioned on the website, but it complements the firm's eldercare and kitchen operations and deserves time to build demand.
